# Definition 
**Postpartum Hemorrhage** (PPH) is heavy vaginal bleeding after delivery. 

Early PPH occurs <24 hours after delivery. 
Late PPH occurs >24 hours after delivery. 

# Risk factors 
- Prolonged labor
- Fetal macrosomia 
- Intra-amniotic infection 

# Causes 
- retained products of conception
- postpartum endometritis 
- inadequate placental site involution 

# Management 
- Dx: pelvic US 
- Tx: D&C
